about: Place-name lookup for scripts/refresh-fires.mjs, built by scripts/build-fire-admin.mjs. Points only. IDN and MYS list ADM2 centres (regency/city, district) with their first-level region (province, state) found by point-in-polygon; IDN applies the 2022 Papua split by regency name. Other countries list ADM1 centres (name: null) used only to name clusters. A hotspot takes the region of the nearest point in its country: approximate, not a boundary.

method.point: Area-weighted centroid of the largest polygon; nearest interior point when the centroid falls outside.
method.adm1: Point-in-polygon against geoBoundaries ADM1 (simplified); nearest edge when the point falls just outside.
